scientific.integrity: The all-orders argument reduces a selected set to the induced graph \(K_a\vee\overline{K_b}\) and proves the perfect-matching condition directly. The packaged exhaustive checker reconstructs the graph and tests matchings independently for \(1\le r,n\le7\); this finite computation is a stress test and not the infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete split graphs \(K_r\vee\overline{K_n}\) with \(r,n\ge1\), not arbitrary split graphs.
The 2016 paired-domination-polynomial proceedings record was retrievable only as an abstract/one-page record; its unspecified standard families create a residual overlap risk.
Database and literature searches reduce but do not eliminate the possibility of an unindexed equivalent formula.

title: Paired-domination polynomial of complete split graphs
